mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.registration_id AS registrationId, p.doctor_id AS doctorId, d.name AS doctorName, p.patient_id AS patientId, pt.name AS patientName, p.medicine_list AS medicineList, p.total_amount AS totalAmount, p.notes, p.status, p.create_time AS createTime FROM prescription p LEFT JOIN doctor d ON d.id = p.doctor_id LEFT JOIN patient pt ON pt.id = p.patient_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
